title: The Yen Hits 160: Japan's Intervention Gamble
description: The Japanese yen is plunging toward the psychological 160 mark against the dollar, driven by hot US inflation and Fed rate hike bets. We break down why Tokyo is issuing stern warnings, what intervention actually costs, and how a widening policy gap leaves Japan scrambling.
